49493.ov: An ambitious villager tries to become a politician. However, he must overcome many challenges in his quest while also trying to fulfil his mother's dream.

875349.ov: Ram Joshi is a Brahmin poet, who through his love of poetry and dance starts associating with the tamasha artists.  He falls in love with the tamasha dancer Baya.  The film follows his descent into acoholism and his redemption from it through poetry.

1087445.ov: Dishkiyaoon is a Marathi movie released on 10 Feb, 2023. The movie is directed by Pritam SK Patil and featured Prathamesh Parab as lead character.

1186901.ov: Vishvanath and Sudha's lives take an ugly turn when they lose their only son in a train bombing. Sudha has a nervous breakdown and Vishvanath takes it upon himself to help his wife.

1482837.t: Sa La Te Sa La Na Te
1482837.ov: A commentary about the state of journalism on the backdrop of environmental exploitation of the ecologically sensitive Tadoba Tiger Reserve, the film explores the consequences of modern profiteering-driven news on the world, and on personal relationships.

1486549.ov: As a young boy, Ramesh witnesses the murder of his father and assault of his mother. Now an adult, he marries the daughter of his mother's assailant.

1533013.t: The Old Bull knows, or Once Knew
1533013.ov: In a forgotten nomadic settlement built on a cremation ground, an aging bull named Shankar prepares to leave his home, echoing the slow disappearance of the Nandiwale people's way of life.

1608277.ov: In a world where love is filtered, scored and predicted, a couple in Pune, India, collides in a fierce, consuming romance. What begins in urgency and desire slowly fractures. Time intrudes. Ambition shifts. Affection turns conditional. What once felt infinite begins to bruise and break.

1758933.ov: Narayan Fad is a man living in a tribal village, who comes to the city for his wife's cancer treatment along with their daughter. The film portrays Narayan's desperation to save his wife and stretch himself to make things back to normal.

tv205141.ov: Unwanted by her family, Aboli loses her confidence and struggles in life. However, Ankush enters her life with love and hope
